department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Fall applications are due February 1; PhD applicants from outside the US have until February 28.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is not required for entry to the graduate programs.
gre_general.quote: The general Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required for students entering our graduate programs

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Admitted applicants are considered for teaching assistantships; the page does not promise funding for all.
funding.quote: All admitted applicants are automatically considered for teaching assistantships (TAs), without any separate application process

entry_route.value: Applicants with only a bachelor's degree are encouraged to apply directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: applicants with Bachelor degree only and a desire to pursue Ph.D. are encouraged to apply for our Ph.D. programs directly

english_waiver.value: Only a degree from a US, UK or Canadian university waives the test; an Indian degree does not.
english_waiver.quote: If you have a degree from a university in the US, UK, or Canada, we can waive the language test requirement

notes: Department page quotes TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.5 and Duolingo 115 for international applicants; the TOEFL figure is on the pre-2026 scale, so no TOEFL override was saved. Computer Engineering PhD is also run by this department (same February 1 Fall deadline); see the ECE record notes.
